faq.q1: Why should I check in daily?
faq.a1: Health rarely deteriorates in a single day. It usually starts with small signs we tend to ignore: extra fatigue, dizziness, poor sleep, thirst, hand tremor, palpitations, or simply feeling "off". A daily check-in records those signals, surfaces unusual trends earlier, and lets caregivers know when to pay attention.
faq.q2: What is the daily AI Check-in?
faq.a2: It's a short conversation Asinu starts every day to capture how you're feeling. For example: are you tired, dizzy, short of breath, having chest pain, hand tremor, or anything unusual today? The goal is to make sure you don't miss small day-to-day changes.
faq.q3: What does "based on your health profile" mean?
faq.a3: Asinu uses the information you've shared — age, conditions, vitals, lifestyle, recent check-ins — to ask more relevant questions. For example, if you have a history of high blood sugar, the assistant pays closer attention to fatigue, thirst, hand tremor, sweating, and unusual feelings after meals.
faq.q4: Free already includes health tracking. What does An Tam add?
faq.a4: Health tracking, AI chat, voice and full history are free. An Tam adds the AI call center, multiple protected people and automatic Early Signals for the family.
faq.q5: How much history does the Free plan keep?
faq.a5: The Free plan keeps and shows your full health and AI Chat history, with no 30-day limit.
faq.a6: Free supports one Care Circle connection. An Tam expands the circle so more family members can coordinate care.
faq.q7: What's the benefit of voice check-in and voice logging?
faq.a7: Voice makes health logging faster and is free for every account.
faq.q8: What does "specialist connection — coming soon" mean?
faq.a8: It's a feature in development so users have more options when they need to talk to a clinician. Free users will queue up when it launches; An Tam users will be prioritized. It does not replace emergency services or in-person care.
faq.a9: No. Asinu does not replace specialists, does not diagnose conditions, and does not prescribe treatment. It helps you track health day-to-day, capture abnormal signs, remind you earlier, and prepare clearer information when you talk to a specialist or caregiver.
faq.q10: When should I choose An Tam?
faq.a10: Choose An Tam when your family needs AI call center follow-up, multiple protected people, or automatic Early Signals each week and when health worsens.
